subject.title: docs: define Inventory client and distribution contracts

question: Should the repository merge these Inventory-owned contracts now, including the documented handoff to Commerce and EmDash, before their implementation and compatibility proof are available?
rationale: The PR introduces future CLI, provider-selection, and plugin-distribution contracts across products; AGENTS.md reserves product decisions and merge authorization for explicit human approval.

options.title: Approve the contract boundary
options.body: Merge the documentation locks as the approved implementation boundary while retaining all runtime and compatibility gates.

options.title: Narrow the contracts
options.body: Keep the PR open and remove or defer the Commerce and EmDash commitments until their owning tracks approve them.

recommendation.title: Approve the contract boundary
recommendation.body: Merge the documentation locks as the approved implementation boundary while retaining all runtime and compatibility gates.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent merged architecture contract and this follow-up documentation surface.
